purpose: Teach: 伊達/沸い/問答/贈ら/リスナー/河原/ペダル/バク

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さん、本気で、絶対、伊達メガネ、絶対、買ってきたよ、本気で、絶対、お洒落
lines.en: Mom, Dad—he really did buy fake glasses! They're so stylish!
lines.style: Bright, proud announcement. Quick tempo, bouncing energy. Opens wide on the revelation. Breathless with excitement about the discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お湯、本気で、絶対、ヤカンで、絶対、沸いたわよ、翔くん、お茶、絶対、入れましょうね
lines.en: Yes. The water's really boiled in the kettle now, Sho. Let's make tea together, shall we?
lines.style: Warm, gentle confirmation. Soft attack on the opening word. Slow, purposeful pace. Includes him in the next small task like it matters—because to her, it does.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、問答、絶対、無用で、ぼくに、絶対、優しいんだよ、ママ、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Dad doesn't even ask—he's just kind to me like that, Mom. I'm really grateful.
lines.style: Sincere, wondering tone. Quiet conviction underneath. Speaks slowly, turning the observation over. Slight wonder that kindness comes without conditions.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんから、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、贈られたわよ、翔くん、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Granny sent us a gift, Sho. We should really thank her for it, shouldn't we?
lines.style: Tender, affirming tone. Soft opening. Unhurried pace. Frames gratitude as something natural and important—gently teaching him the shape of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、ラジオの、絶対、リスナー、絶対、なんだよね、ママ
lines.en: Dad listens to the radio a lot, doesn't he, Mom?
lines.style: Quiet, observant. Musing rather than asking. Slow, gentle cadence. The thoughtfulness of a child noticing something small about someone he loves.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 公園の河原、本気で、絶対、家族で、絶対、ピクニック、絶対、行きましょうね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: We should take a family picnic down to the riverside park soon, Sho. That'll be really fun.
lines.style: Warm, inviting tone. Bright but not hurried. Opens with ease, like she's already imagining it. The kind of plan a mother makes to hold a moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 自転車のペダル、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、もっと、絶対、上手に、漕ぎたいよ、ママ
lines.en: I want to get better at pedaling my bike, Mom. I really do.
lines.style: Determined but small-voiced. Quiet conviction. Steady pace. The earnest wish of a child working to master something just beyond his reach.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 動物園、本気で、絶対、バク、絶対、家族で、絶対、見に行きたいわね、翔くん、本気で、絶対、楽しみ
lines.en: We should all go see the tapirs at the zoo sometime, Sho. I'd really love that.
lines.style: Warm, gentle invitation. Soft opening. Unhurried, thoughtful pace. Speaks as if the idea has taken root in her—something she genuinely wants to share with him.
